description: Follows a site's links and reads every page. Returns a jobId; poll it with web_crawl_status. Charged up front for the pages it is allowed to read (`limit`), and the pages it never reads are refunded. Use web_map first if you only need the urls. Reference for the oassis API: https://oassis.dev/openapi.json

binaryAs.description: How a screenshot or a PDF comes back. `base64` is the only value today.

block.description: What not to load, which makes a render faster and cheaper. `resourceTypes` takes image, font, stylesheet, media… and `urlPatterns` are regular expressions, not globs: `\.svg$`, not `*.svg`.

controls.description: Options for the `controls` format: `visibleOnly`, and `limit` (1 to 1000) to cut the map.

excludePaths.description: Discard urls whose path contains one of these. Up to twenty. It wins over `includePaths`.

formats.description: Outputs you want in the same response. `controls` is the map of what can be clicked; `elements` needs `selectors`; `json` needs `json.prompt` or `json.schema`. A screenshot or a PDF is not available here: every result is kept until you collect it. Ask for those one url at a time on web_scrape.

includePaths.description: Keep only urls whose path contains one of these. Up to twenty.

includeSubdomains.description: Treat subdomains of the same site as part of it.

json.description: For the `json` format: a `prompt` describing what to pull out, a JSON `schema` to fill, or both.

limit.description: Pages this crawl may read, up to 200. Charged up front; what it does not read comes back.

links.description: Options for the `links` format: `visibleOnly`, `excludeExternal` to keep only internal links.

maxAge.description: Accept an answer up to this many milliseconds old. A cache hit costs $0.0002 instead of the format price. Leave it out to force a fresh render.

maxDepth.description: How far from the starting page to follow links. 0 reads only the starting page.

request.description: How to make the request: `headers`, `cookies`, `userAgent`, and `auth` for basic authentication.

wait.description: When to consider the page loaded: `until` (load, domcontentloaded, networkidle0, networkidle2), `selector` to wait for, `timeout` in ms.

name: web_crawl
